name: singlet_spatial_preproc_in_tissue_detection
title: In-tissue spot and bin detection
description: Flags each spot or bin as on tissue or background, with an optional probability and optional local-artifact flags. The default method spaceranger_flag validates and keeps the existing Space Ranger in_tissue column and reads no image. Use otsu, felzenszwalb or weka on the H&E image when that column is absent or must be checked. count_band is a total-UMI background proxy, not a tissue detector. Writes obs/in_tissue; does not subset the matrix or filter transcripts.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Detector. spaceranger_flag needs obs/in_tissue; image methods need an H&E image; count_band uses total UMI only.

device.description: Execution device; image methods and weka run on CPU, so auto selects CPU for them.

seed.description: Random seed for weka and the artifact k-means; deterministic methods ignore it.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing or writing members.

overwrite.description: Replace existing obs/in_tissue and related members instead of failing.

artifact_flags.description: Also write obs/artifact_local using the spotsweeper options; regional artifacts only, not folds or tears.

image.description: Options shared by the image methods otsu, felzenszwalb and weka.

image_key.description: Key of the H&E image under uns/spatial/<library_id>/images.

library_id.description: Library to process; null uses the only library in the dataset and fails when there are several.

corners_are_background.description: Use the four image corners as background seeds and set the background polarity.

corner_size_pct.description: Corner box size as a fraction of image height and width.

border_margin_px.description: Pixels excluded at every border to mask the fiducial frame; set explicitly on Visium images.

min_specimen_area_frac.description: Smallest kept tissue region as a fraction of the image area.

close_holes_smaller_than_frac.description: Fill holes smaller than this fraction of the image area.

auto_max_pixels.description: Downscale the image to at most this many pixels before processing; the scale is reported.

felzenszwalb.description: Superpixel options for the felzenszwalb method.

sigma_frac.description: Gaussian blur as a fraction of the short image side, clipped to 1 to 5 pixels.

scale_coef.description: Felzenszwalb scale as a multiple of the target superpixel area.

min_size_coef.description: Minimum superpixel size as a multiple of the target superpixel area.

weka.description: Random-forest options for the weka method; requires corners_are_background true.

sigma_min.description: Smallest Gaussian scale of the multiscale pixel features.

sigma_max.description: Largest Gaussian scale of the multiscale pixel features.

edges.description: Include edge-filter responses among the pixel features.

pseudo_tissue_percentile.description: Percentile of distance-from-background above which non-corner pixels seed tissue.

pseudo_min_pixels.description: Minimum number of tissue seed pixels, taken from the largest distances when short.

rf_estimators.description: Number of trees in the random forest.

rf_max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth; null grows trees without a depth limit.

rf_max_samples.description: Fraction of seed pixels drawn for each tree.

refine_with_classifier.description: Run a second-stage classifier that refines the first mask.

count_band.description: Total-UMI band for the count_band method; a background proxy only.

layer.description: Layer whose column sums give total UMI per unit.

count_min.description: Units with total UMI below this are called background.

count_max.description: Units with total UMI above this are excluded from tissue calls.

spotsweeper.description: Local-variance options used when artifact_flags is true.

n_order.description: Number of neighbourhood orders over which local variance is computed.

shape.description: Lattice neighbourhood shape; hexagonal matches Visium spot geometry.

log.description: Apply a log transform to the mitochondrial percentage before local variance.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/in_tissue. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: n_units, n_in_tissue, method, scale, image_shape_px, n_artifact_local (null unless artifact_flags).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
